scoring_justification: Full recompute of energies/geometries from raw DFT files is infeasible in the verifier sandbox; compare reported values to hidden paper gold with tolerances and structural trend checks.

hidden_assets.purpose: Hidden gold values for physisorption (adsorption energies, heights, bond lengths) from the paper
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table/Section III.A: pristine 0.13 eV, 2.824 Å, 1.263 Å; N-doped 0.31 eV, 2.461 Å, 2.775 Å, 1.280 Å
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from the paper's text and Fig. 1 caption
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the actual paper-reported values; the reference solver writes them, and a correct reproduction will approximate them.

hidden_assets.purpose: Hidden gold values for O atom chemisorption (site, energy, bond lengths) from the paper
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table I and text: pristine bridge 3.97 eV, 1.472 Å; N-doped top 4.68 eV, 1.323 Å
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from the paper's Table I and discussion
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Same as above; these are the actual paper values for the most stable sites.

hidden_assets.purpose: Hidden gold values for O2 dissociation barriers from the paper
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Sections III.C and Fig. 6/7: pristine 2.39 eV, N-doped 1.20 eV
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from the paper's text and figure captions
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the main headline quantities; the reference solver writes them.

outputs.description: O2 physisorption geometries and adsorption energies on pristine and N-doped graphene.
Single O atom chemisorption site, energy, and bond lengths on pristine and N-doped graphene.
O2 dissociation energy barriers on pristine and N-doped graphene.

output_contract.notes: Quantities are compared to hidden reference values within tolerances. Trends (N-doped adsorption energy > pristine, N-doped dissociation barrier < pristine) are also verified.
